[b]New Side Mission: Vehicle Theft[/b]
A new side mission system is being added to the game, allowing you to steal vehicles from garages located in different areas of the map. In these missions, you'll need to sneak into target garages, steal the car, and deliver it to a designated location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/763e6dd0e120c3a6f3aefdefde89047ed6499230.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/413b6f8b678c71e8ab7fc17e03281c7856609fe4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/1b1101af7ee08970e31ad306b8d5038720be6c3a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/c1e750d288363dfccb1ef2bfc2adbd05fad2d995.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/a116571eeb515cd9310abea9c7e7275c8868d9c9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/38e9ffd83f33150d31bdca4731671293813fd839.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/e399e164d8a4f582f54d7b233899c59971da3564.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/4704ec0c242a390025c499ae0e36c18b5c4ba237.png[/img]
[b]Dismantle or Drive[/b]
You can earn mission money and car parts from the vehicles you dismantle, and sell those parts in your own shop. Alternatively, you can choose to keep and drive the cars illegally for a certain fee.

[b][Fixes and Content][/b]
[list]
[*] Vehicles had to be started manually every time the game was reloaded; now fixed to start automatically.
[*] Sliding door sounds of some vehicles have been fixed.
[*] Junkyard location added.
[*] Vehicle theft mechanic added.
[*] 8 new stealable vehicles added.
[*] Vehicle parts that can be sold in the shop have been added.
[*] Vehicle handling has been improved.
[*] New Lockpick skills added.
[/list]
[h3][u][b]We’ll keep sharing new updates to improve your gaming experience. Your support means a lot—please help us by leaving a review on Steam. Thank you! Stay tuned![/b][/u][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2625620/Storage_Dealer_Simulator/?curator_clanid=38756390
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616550/Car_Dealership_Simulator_2/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/1313c7fd58ec5e5bc4ab4f446b4a3debac9fa884.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Also, don’t forget to add our new game, Car Dealership Simulator 2, to your wishlist to follow its development and stay updated on future updates![/h3][/b]

notes.title: Storage Dealer Simulator Devlog
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Storage Dealer Simulator "[b]Car Theft System[/b]" Devlog

[h3]Dear players,[/h3]
"[b]Storage Dealer Simulator has not been abandoned. Development is actively ongoing. Thank you to everyone who continues to support us and patiently waits for updates. Your feedback truly matters to us."

Please keep in mind that every update takes time, and by showing patience, we will be able to offer a better gaming experience. If you enjoy the game, leaving a review on Steam is very valuable. Your comments help improve the game and allow us to reach a wider audience. Also, feel free to share your ideas for upcoming updates with us.

Thank you for your support![/b]

[b]New Side Mission: Vehicle Theft[/b]
A new side mission system is being added to the game, allowing you to steal vehicles from garages located in different areas of the map. In these missions, you'll need to sneak into target garages, steal the car, and deliver it to a designated location.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/a116571eeb515cd9310abea9c7e7275c8868d9c9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/a230aa2b0f473921c89f9a168435f2cc449fdd96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/38e9ffd83f33150d31bdca4731671293813fd839.jpg[/img]

[b]Vehicle Salvage[/b]
You will steal vehicles, take them to the car scrapyard, and dismantle them for cash. Sneak into garages, steal the vehicle, and deliver it to the scrapyard to earn your reward!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/e2d3a28b563cae3d3189fd3e728cb95092b1393b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/43f36f57a0ae765c393fa8838d9151d400a9bb87.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/7db32d74bb1169a6727fb4e96abccbef5b40c3a9.jpg[/img]

[h3]"When this update is added to the game, we will share a detailed roadmap for upcoming updates. We will provide more information about new missions, features, and improvements, aiming to continuously enhance your gaming experience."[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616550/Car_Dealership_Simulator_2/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/162893dce73eb99b2c50265cc3c7cbfc5a83bbf8.png[/img]

[h3]We will also be sharing new information about [b]Car Dealership Simulator 2[/b]. Make sure to add it to your wishlist so you can follow the game's development and stay updated on future updates.[/h3]

notes.title: Storage Dealer Simulator 0.8 Update
notes.content:
Hello dear players! 🎮

First of all, we’d like to announce that we’ve changed the name of our game from [b]Dealer Simulator[/b] to [b]Storage Dealer Simulator[/b].

Don’t worry — development is still ongoing and the game is definitely not abandoned. More updates are on the way! We’ll be announcing the roadmap for the full release in the next update. We’ll continue progressing along that roadmap to make the game even better. 🚗🔧

[b]We kindly ask players who experienced save issues to log in and check if the problem has been resolved, and to update their Steam reviews if everything is working fine. Thank you in advance for your support![/b]

[u][b]Note: Players who previously encountered save issues and haven't deleted the game or their save files will be able to continue from where they left off.[/b][/u]

[h1]Storage Dealer Simulator 0.8 Update[/h1]

[b][Fixes and Content][/b]

[list]
[*] [u][b]The issue where save files were getting corrupted or failing to load has been fixed.[/b][/u]
[*] The auction system wasn’t saving; this issue has been fixed.
[*] New Steam Achievements have been added.
[/list]

[h3]We're excited to introduce our new game: [b]Car Dealership Simulator 2![/b] 🎮[/h3]

We need your support to continue improving this game. Your feedback and ideas are incredibly valuable to us. Check out [b]Car Dealership Simulator 2[/b] and support us today!

[previewyoutube=ZeEZzSYY5ew;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616550/Car_Dealership_Simulator_2

notes.title: Dealer Simulator 0.4 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Dealer Simulator 0.4 Update

[Fixes and Content]
[list]
[*] The issue of trailers and vehicles being deleted when touching the trash bin has been fixed.
[*] The issue where vehicles and some Trailers from large hangars were not being deleted even after the hangar was refreshed the next day has been fixed.
[*] Vehicle reset button has been added.
[*] You can now physically push trailers. If your trailer is stuck somewhere, you can free it by pushing it.
[*] If you hold down the [b](E)[/b] key on broken electronic devices that come out of warehouses, you can dismantle them and turn them into Scrap Parts. The number of times an item can be repaired with scrap has been increased to 5.
[/list]

notes.title: Dealer Simulator 0.0.6 Big Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h3]Dealer Simulator 0.0.6 [b]Big Update[/b][/h3]

[h2]Auction System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/8567bfbf0acdabb1fed293b8591f87ed9c13d468.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/f464a3525c6cf1bb21bcaf69117f5b97b7cb3599.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/ece12d8db445d0600c028b86410e43f76f20d1dd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/efbbc71973f20829b1f22cd8c6d7fa85e00eae37.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/89a456d87e34dfb81e681226fef83cfc6fa67eb8.png[/img]

More than 30 items exclusively for auction. It includes historical artifacts, armor, paintings and decorative items. The number of these items will increase in next updates.

[b][Info][/b]

- You need to have a shop for the auction system.
- The auction is repeated every 4 days.
- Items sold at auction are quite expensive.
- In order to find out the prices of the items in the auction, you need the worker in the shop doing research.

[h2]Driveable RC System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/5aaf95b7a2e83b6e3a7c8f2a02e2de3f889fe49c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/4cae330fe72a87da2de8888d85c34bba17c4b4ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/a2add221c4b19ef1ea7b8906fa484e00f7cd1879.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/d5b8cc6295a58b18819d7ec2b4160cd0b44d0083.png[/img]

[h2]New Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/fd39d774b36ab808aecb2f36915948738b634e96.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/82825b31358880e01b1688c445822c3b612ed3ba.png[/img]

[h2]Environmental Improvements and New Roads[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/60d3dd21928fd3bd32fcb6dfd86ddc5d477bba54.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/31553d7b705818a7f3109a9e662e4f5ae603faa3.png[/img]

[Fixes and Content]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where baseball bats could not be sold.
[*] Sometimes there was a problem of not being able to sleep, it has been fixed.
[*] If you are inside the store, environmental sounds are reduced.
[*] Auction system added.
[*] New items have been added. (PC, RC, Airsoft Toys and more.)
[*] Environmental Improvements and New Roads.
[*] Music volume slider has been added to the settings section of the Main Menu.
[*] Sometimes items that fell on the floor in the shop could not be picked up. This has been fixed.
[*] Added items to vendors in the market area.
[/list]
